verdicts.seen: The outcome names Chief's reply in the chat thread. The newest message at the bottom reads 'Good morning, Umer. Ready when you are.' beside Chief's avatar, under the user's 'Good morning Chief. Please say hello back in one short sentence.' The Chief tab is active and no overlay hides the thread.
